name: outside-interface-never-asserted
description: A value converted to an interface a package outside the program declares keeps, beside the methods that interface requires, only the methods by which it implements an interface a type assertion or a type switch case in that package's source names. A method only an interface that package declares and never asserts requires is reported, exported or not, and so is a method only an exported interface of a package it imports requires when that package's source never asserts it. A value converted to io.Writer keeps the methods of the interfaces the io package asserts, and its Read method, which io.Reader requires and the io package never asserts, is reported.
